grid_definition: POWER/MERRA-2 point coordinates treated as 0.5-degree latitude by 0.625-degree longitude rectangular cells centered on each coordinate.
area_method: intersection area measured in an India Albers equal-area projection after geographic intersection.
limitations: Boundary matches are provisional and do not establish historical district equivalence.
Grid-cell rectangles are a documented spatial approximation of POWER point coverage.
District estimates aggregate grid-cell model outputs and can hide local variation.
